propositions: Three separate code paths (normal compaction, fsck rebuild, crash recovery) independently re-derive identical decisions about candidate listing, snapshot file detection, snapshot envelope building, and retired file restoration.

Duplicated logic appears across compact_txn, compact_rebuild, and compact_recovery for snapshot envelope construction (source_event_uuids and compacted_at keys) and the rename-back rule with its data-loss guard.
The two-arm snapshot-detection rule (needs folding condition) is separately implemented in compact._scan_snapshot_state and compact_trigger.ticket_needs_folding with overlapping probes.
A stray non-.json file in a ticket directory was being cited in source_event_uuids and renamed to *.retired by the rebuild, revealing an inconsistency in the candidate filter requirements.

The compact_plan module consolidates these shared derivations (Candidate listing, snapshot detection, envelope building, file restoration) into a single owner, with guard code to prevent reintroduction of duplication outside the owner.
Normal fold and rebuild paths must produce identical source_event_uuids in their SNAPSHOT events and agree on the envelope key set, verified by equivalence testing.
